# Business Today

> > India's premier business news platform delivering real-time market updates, financial analysis, and comprehensive coverage of stocks, economy, and corporate India.

Business Today is a leading Indian business news portal offering live share market data, stock analysis, economic news, and in-depth business journalism across English and Hindi. The platform combines breaking news, expert analysis, video content, and rankings to serve investors, traders, and business professionals.

## Key Topics

- Stock Market
- Share Market News
- Sensex & Nifty
- Indian Economy
- Business News
- IPOs
- Personal Finance
- Trading Strategy
- Market Analysis
- Banking Sector
- AI Startups
- Union Budget
- Financial News
- Business Rankings
- Capital Markets

## Core Platforms

- [Business Today - Homepage](https://www.businesstoday.in): Homepage offering latest business news, share market updates, economy news, stocks, IPO, finance, crypto.
- [BT Bazaar - Hindi Business News](https://bazaar.businesstoday.in): Hindi business news portal offering market updates, share market news, petrol prices, personal finance.
- [Business Today Magazine](https://www.businesstoday.in/magazine): Business Today Magazine digital editions with cover stories, in-depth analysis, industry insights.
- [BT TV - Video News Hub](https://www.businesstoday.in/bt-tv): BT TV video hub with live business news, share market videos, market analysis clips.

## Markets & Stock Data

- [Share Market News & Updates](https://www.businesstoday.in/markets): Live share market news with Sensex, Nifty updates, stock analysis, market outlook.
- [Share Market Indices](https://www.businesstoday.in/indices): Live NSE/BSE indices including Nifty 50, Bank, Pharma, IT, Midcap with market tracking.
- [Stock Performance & IPOs](https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/company-stock): Stock performance data, IPO updates, BSE/NSE news, quarterly results, mutual funds.
- [Trending Stocks](https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/trending-stocks): Trending stocks news with top stocks to buy, recommendations, AI stocks, market updates.
- [Stock Market Headlines](https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/stocks): Stock market news headlines, share market breaking news, tips, stock analysis.

## Magazine & Analysis

- [Cover Stories](https://www.businesstoday.in/magazine/cover-story): Magazine cover stories on AI startups, banking sector, trade policy, IT industry trends.
- [Deep Dive Articles](https://www.businesstoday.in/magazine/deep-dive): In-depth long-form articles on business analysis, economy trends, industry insights.
- [Executive Interviews](https://www.businesstoday.in/magazine/interview): Exclusive interviews with industry leaders, entrepreneurs, business tycoons, innovators.
- [Editor's Notes](https://www.businesstoday.in/magazine/editors-note-0): Editor's notes on financial analysis, AI sovereignty, banking, geopolitical conflicts, trade.

## Video Content & Education

- [Market Today Videos](https://www.businesstoday.in/bt-tv/market-today): Stock market videos covering Sensex, Nifty, market volatility, trading strategy analysis.
- [Easynomics - Economy Series](https://www.businesstoday.in/bt-tv/easynomics): Easynomics video series on economy, retail investors, IPO slots, capital markets, SEBI.
- [BT Explainer Videos](https://www.businesstoday.in/bt-tv/bt-explainer): Explainer videos on share market, economy, stock market, personal finance, current affairs.
- [Drive Today - Automotive](https://www.businesstoday.in/bt-tv/drive-today): Drive Today video series on car launches, reviews, electric vehicles, luxury models.

## Special Reports & Rankings

- [BT500 - Top Companies Ranking](https://www.businesstoday.in/bt500): BT500 ranking of India's top 500 companies with billionaires list, performance comparison metrics.
- [Union Budget 2026 Coverage](https://www.businesstoday.in/union-budget): Union Budget 2026 live updates with key announcements, income tax changes, policy highlights.
